chunks: As for the right of your creditor who demands his due: if you are wealthy, pay him back; and if you are in straitened circumstances, satisfy him with good words and send him away with gentleness.
ai.seo_question: How should a debtor treat their creditor if they cannot pay the debt immediately?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin emphasizes that financial insolvency does not absolve one of the moral duty to maintain dignity and courtesy (husn al-qawl) toward the creditor. This instruction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on preserving social harmony and preventing the creditor's distress, treating the delay in payment as a test of character rather than merely a legal obligation. The 'gentle return' (rad lafif) signifies a respectful negotiation or acknowledgment of debt that preserves the creditor's honor.
